title: helm(private): refactor values schema and init hooks to improve upgrade/rollback stability
author: Marco Liu
description:
Motivation: Private deployments have seen intermittent failures during chart upgrades where init hooks (CRD rehydration and values initialization) could leave resources in a state that prevented rollbacks. This PR refactors the values schema for the redwood-private chart, tightens templating around init hooks, and adds explicit pre-upgrade/pre-rollback jobs and validation to make upgrades deterministic and reversible.

What this PR changes: - Introduces a normalized values.schema.json with explicit versioned keys (private.valuesSchemaVersion) and clearer defaults for networking, storage, and KMS integrations to make automated migrations safer. - Reworks templates/init-job.yaml and templates/hooks/* to separate idempotent initialization from one-time migrations; adds explicit pre-upgrade and pre-rollback hook jobs. - Adds server-side Helm-validate style checks (templates/validate-helpers.tpl) used in CI to catch misconfigurations before cluster apply. - Adds an upgrade compatibility shim that translates legacy value keys (used by older installs) into the new schema at chart render-time when enableLegacyCompatibility is true. The shim logs a deprecation warning in NOTES.txt. - Adds end-to-end helm upgrade/rollback test manifests and a small integration test in .github/workflows/helm-upgrade-rollback.yml. - Extensive docs and release notes (charts/private/README-UPGRADE.md) describing migration steps and example helm commands.

Compatibility and migration: - Default behavior preserves existing installs: enableLegacyCompatibility is enabled by default for two chart releases to avoid forcing immediate changes. Operators are encouraged to run the included migration job to adopt the new schema and then disable the shim. - No automatic deletion of user resources. The schema adds validation for fields that were previously optional but commonly misconfigured. The chart will fail early with a descriptive error if a required field is missing.

Testing and CI: - Added unit templates tests for schema validations. - Added a GitHub Actions workflow that runs a local kind cluster upgrade/rollback scenario; workflow is marked slow and runs on merge. - CI initially failed due to a timing race in the pre-upgrade hook; fixed by making the init job wait for CRD readiness with exponential backoff.

Why this matters: Improves reliability of private upgrades (fewer manual rollbacks), reduces incident surface for on-prem customers, and gives operators a clear migration path with observable validation and release notes.

feat(helm): add pre-upgrade and pre-rollback hook jobs with explicit CRD readiness checks
fix(ci): add helm template validation and upgrade/rollback e2e workflow
docs: add charts/private/README-UPGRADE.md with migration steps
test(helm): add template unit tests for schema and hook ordering
review_comments: Sofia: Can we make the legacy shim opt-in instead of opt-out? Some customers ran into silent migrations in the past.

Marco: Decided to keep it enabled for two releases by default with clear deprecation message in NOTES and README-UPGRADE. We discussed in person and agreed that emergency rollback surface is larger if we force none.
requested_changes: Ravi: Please add a timeout + retry helper to the pre-upgrade hook so it doesn't block forever during cluster upgrades.
Marco: Added exponential backoff and an explicit 10m timeout with logs; test updated to simulate delayed CRD readiness.
Tara: Add more examples for common KMS misconfigurations in README-UPGRADE so customers can self-remediate.
Marco: Expanded README with KMS examples and potential cloud provider notes.
ci_log_summary: Initial run: helm template validation failed due to nil pointer in _compatibility-shim.tpl (fixed)
Second run: E2E kind upgrade job timed out at 9m; increased hook wait with exponential backoff
Final run: All checks passed (lint, template-test, unit-tests, upgrade-rollback e2e)
release_notes:
- Refactor private chart values schema to versioned format.
- Add pre-upgrade and pre-rollback hooks with CRD readiness checks.
- Include compatibility shim for legacy values (enabled for 2 releases).
- Add upgrade/rollback e2e tests and docs (README-UPGRADE.md).
notes_for_ops: Operators should read charts/private/README-UPGRADE.md before upgrading. Typical workflow: 1) helm repo update && helm pull && helm template --values old-values.yaml to verify; 2) run charts/private/tests/upgrade-rollback-test.yaml in a staging cluster; 3) run migration job with enableLegacyCompatibility=true; 4) disable shim in next release and set valuesSchemaVersion. Contact SRE if unexpected resources remain after rollback.
